top_signals.title: BOJ will keep raising benchmark rate to cap price trend at 2%, board member says
top_signals.summary: Swap contracts show a roughly 97% probability that the Bank of Japan will raise borrowing costs from 1% at the end of a two-day meeting on Sept. 18.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Four Japanese scientists win prestigious U.S. Lasker Awards
top_signals.summary: One received the prize for his work on a sleep-regulating brain chemical, and a trio, for discovering an antibody therapy for hemophilia A patients.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
